about: Parent companies that run several broker sites, which sites belong to each, and opt-outs known to remove a listing from other sites too. Facts only; descriptions are written for this project. Each entry records where it came from. An opt-out email is applied automatically only when email_verified is true; otherwise it is kept in the notes for an admin to confirm. one_optout_covers is true when one opt-out through the family reaches all of its sites (the Brokers page counts them as covered); approx_sites is the rough size of a network of look-alike sites that aren't listed one by one; not_covered lists family sites that need their own opt-out.

parents.name: StateRecords.org network
parents.email_source: Confirmed by project maintainer; see BROKERS.md
parents.notes: The state arrests.org and arrestrecords.org sites redirect to staterecords.org and share one opt-out inbox.

parents.name: CourtRecords.us network
parents.notes: State court-records sites redirect to courtrecords.us and share one opt-out inbox.

parents.name: PeopleConnect (Intelius)
parents.email_source: BADBOOL lists this address as one of Intelius's opt-out channels
parents.notes: One suppression request through PeopleConnect covers the sites it owns. Intelius may ask to confirm an old address, phone or email by email before it can find the record; only confirm details it already shows.
parents.not_covered_source: redact.dev Intelius/PeopleConnect guide (updated 2026-05-21): Classmates needs its own request

parents.name: BeenVerified
parents.notes: Separate opt-outs exist for people search and property search. Allows only one opt-out per email address, and each opt-out must be confirmed by clicking an emailed link.

parents.name: Whitepages
parents.notes: The opt-out ends with an automated phone call and a code. 411.com uses the same opt-out. Whitepages Premium listings may need a separate request.

parents.name: Spokeo
parents.notes: FreePeopleDirectory listings are removed through Spokeo's opt-out page. The web opt-out needs the listing URL and an emailed confirmation click. Paid Spokeo accounts may still see removed data.

parents.name: InfoPay
parents.email_source: The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (public domain) InfoPay entries; redact.dev InfoTracer guide (updated 2026-08-11)
parents.notes: InfoPay runs these sites. The built-in InfoPay plugin emails one request naming all of them; InfoTracer has its own opt-out page too, so the family alone isn't counted as covering every site.
parents.source: The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (public domain) InfoPay entries; redact.dev InfoTracer guide

parents.name: PeopleFinders
parents.notes: The PeopleFinders opt-out also covers PrivateEye and PublicRecordsNow.

cascades.notes: BADBOOL says opting out of SmartBackgroundChecks will likely also remove PeopleFinders listings.

BADBOOL's October 2023 update dropped these two because successful Intelius and BeenVerified opt-outs removed them. The current list includes them again with their own opt-outs, so keep opting out of them directly.
cascades.source: BADBOOL changelog note (October 2023) and current entries
